Binding text: epic ruling 6781691009 on #31527, 「a write resolves its address exactly as the read at the same address resolves it」; the read at this cell is ruled and pinned (#33210 (c), #34441): the docblock 「Where the base holds no row at the member, the read moves at a named non-canonical member only」. So the route is the write following the read (the card's second answer); the read is not changed.
Serial constraints cleared: none in flight on these files (PR #35450 merged); sibling cards #35529 (same area, rewrites the exception sentence and three door-request comments this fix may touch) and #35528 queue serially behind this card in area f2-I: fold refused at gate ① (#35524 changes behaviour, #35529/#35528 are text and pins).
